name: Oran AI Data Center / Akid Lotfi AI computing center
developer: Government of Algeria / Ministry of Post and Telecommunications; Algérie Télécom-linked public initiative
notes: DCD reported on 2025-03-20 that the Algerian government had broken ground on an AI data center in Oran's Akid Lotfi district, with the foundation stone laid by Post and Telecommunications Minister Sid Ali Zerrouki. DzairAI's 2025-03-16 report, citing APS and Algeria News Gate, says the facility is Algeria's first AI-dedicated high-performance computing center and will use latest-generation GPUs for researchers, universities, and startups. No MW capacity was disclosed.

name: ISSAL NET Oran Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists ISSAL NET Oran Data Center at Rue N 6, 101 Cite Jourdain, Hai Chouhada, 31007 Oran, Algeria, operated by SARL ISSAL NET, with public cloud/server and virtual data center services and Tier 3 indicated. The Algeria market page lists Oran as one of four Algerian data-center markets and shows one Oran facility. No MW capacity was disclosed.

name: Universite Abbes Laghrour Khenchela data center acquisition and installation
notes: Algerie Marches lists a 2026-06-17 national open tender and a 2026-08-03 award notice for acquisition and installation of a data center for the University of Khenchela, in Khenchela wilaya. Full buyer/award details are access-limited on the aggregator page, so status is marked approved and capacity is left null.
